mainText: <speak><voice name="Salli">Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, it is a clear night out by the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 80 degrees. We have a full moon out tonight, but unfortunately no visible ISS passes. The overnight low will be 69 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Ivy">The city is busy with new initiatives, including a community contest for students to design I Voted stickers for the November election and a new waiver process for those wishing to participate in the Senior Center's popular tri-shaw program.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kendra">We have plenty going on, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Justin">Looking at the weekly report, on July 23, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Lucerne Drive where a 23-year-old man was arrested for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joey">Today's flavor is Snickers Swirl, but since the restaurant is currently closed, you can look forward to stopping by when they open tomorrow at 10:00 AM to try the Georgia Peach flavor.</voice></speak>
